source.label: mtgo.com decklists: Vintage Eternal Weekend: Mox Ruby

notes.text: Placings are from mtgo.com (its final ranking and Top 8 bracket); there was no written coverage. mtgo.com names no archetypes.
Started 2021-11-28 10:00 PST (18:00 UTC); the Top 8 was played that evening Pacific time (early 2021-11-29 UTC).
Magic Online lists each printing of a card on its own line; copies of the same card are added together here.
Seeds are the seeding shown in mtgo.com's Top 8 bracket.
Archetype names are MTGGoldfish's, for consistency across events.
